title: The Bunker
content: From mallworld, does anyone ever end up in the bunker. It's by a forest area, there is multiple entrances and exits. It's not like an army bunker more like a homeless person's bunker. Some of it is underground, but opens up to a bigger area. It's dirty but also has concrete and walls and rooms and stuff. It seems kinda abandoned but also peoples personal items left behind. You would think a bunker area would feel safe but there's always a sense of foreboding.
